title: RHEL 9 must not permit direct logons to the root account using remote access via SSH.
check_summary: Effective sshd config must have PermitRootLogin set to no. Any other value, or a missing or commented-out setting, is a finding.
fix_summary: Set PermitRootLogin no in sshd_config or an sshd_config.d drop-in, then restart sshd.

title: RHEL 9 SSHD must not allow blank passwords.
check_summary: Effective PermitEmptyPasswords must be no. Yes, missing, or commented out is a finding.
fix_summary: Set PermitEmptyPasswords no in sshd_config or a drop-in and restart sshd.

title: RHEL 9 must enable the Pluggable Authentication Module (PAM) interface for SSHD.
check_summary: The SSH daemon must have UsePAM set to yes. No, missing, or commented out is a finding.
fix_summary: Set UsePAM yes in sshd_config or a drop-in and restart sshd.

title: The RHEL 9 SSH server must be configured to use only DOD-approved encryption ciphers employing FIPS 140-3 validated cryptographic hash algorithms.
check_summary: The OpenSSH server crypto-policy backend file must list only the approved AES-GCM and AES-CTR ciphers. Anything else or a missing entry is a finding.
fix_summary: Reinstall crypto-policies, set the system crypto policy to FIPS, and reboot.

title: The RHEL 9 SSH server must be configured to use only Message Authentication Codes (MACs) employing FIPS 140-3 validated cryptographic hash algorithms.
check_summary: The OpenSSH server crypto-policy file's MACs setting must be the approved FIPS set only. Other values or a missing entry is a finding.
fix_summary: Reinstall crypto-policies, set the system crypto policy to FIPS, and reboot.

title: RHEL 9 must not allow a noncertificate trusted host SSH logon to the system.
check_summary: Effective HostbasedAuthentication must be no. Any other value, missing, or commented out is a finding.
fix_summary: Set HostbasedAuthentication no in sshd_config or a drop-in and restart sshd.

title: RHEL 9 must be configured so that all network connections associated with SSH traffic terminate after becoming unresponsive.
check_summary: Effective ClientAliveCountMax must be 1. Missing, another value, or commented out is a finding.
fix_summary: Set ClientAliveCountMax 1 in sshd_config or a drop-in and restart sshd; pair with RHEL-09-255100.

title: RHEL 9 must be configured so that all network connections associated with SSH traffic are terminated after 10 minutes of becoming unresponsive.
check_summary: Effective ClientAliveInterval must be 600 or less in config and in sshd -T output. Missing, higher, or commented out is a finding.
fix_summary: Set ClientAliveInterval 600 in sshd_config or a drop-in and restart sshd; pair with RHEL-09-255095.

title: RHEL 9 SSH daemon must disable remote X connections for interactive users.
check_summary: Effective X11Forwarding must be no, unless documented with the ISSO as an operational need. Yes, missing, or commented out is a finding.
fix_summary: Set X11Forwarding no in sshd_config or a drop-in and restart sshd.

title: RHEL 9 must display the Standard Mandatory DOD Notice and Consent Banner before granting local or remote access to the system via a SSH logon.
check_summary: The sshd Banner keyword must be active and point to a file holding the logon banner. A commented-out Banner is a finding.
fix_summary: Uncomment Banner in sshd config or a drop-in and point it at the banner file, then restart sshd.
command_evidence: sshd -T | grep -i banner; contents of the banner file

title: The RHEL 9 SSH server configuration file must be owned by root.
check_summary: stat on /etc/ssh/sshd_config, sshd_config.d and its files must show root ownership. Any other owner is a finding.
fix_summary: Recursively chown /etc/ssh/sshd_config and /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d to root.

title: RHEL 9 /etc/shadow file must have mode 0000 to prevent unauthorized access.
check_summary: stat of /etc/shadow must show octal mode 0. Anything else is a finding.
fix_summary: chmod 0000 /etc/shadow.

title: RHEL 9 /etc/shadow file must be owned by root.
check_summary: stat of /etc/shadow must show root as owner. Any other owner is a finding.
fix_summary: chown root /etc/shadow.

title: RHEL 9 /etc/passwd file must have mode 0644 or less permissive to prevent unauthorized access.
check_summary: stat of /etc/passwd must show mode 0644 or stricter. Anything looser is a finding.
fix_summary: chmod 0644 /etc/passwd.

title: RHEL 9 /etc/group file must have mode 0644 or less permissive to prevent unauthorized access.
check_summary: stat of /etc/group must show mode 0644 or stricter. Anything looser is a finding.
fix_summary: chmod 0644 /etc/group.

title: RHEL 9 /etc/gshadow file must have mode 0000 or less permissive to prevent unauthorized access.
check_summary: stat of /etc/gshadow must show mode 0. Anything else is a finding.
fix_summary: chmod 0000 /etc/gshadow.

title: The firewalld service on RHEL 9 must be active.
check_summary: systemctl is-active firewalld must report active. Otherwise it is a finding.
fix_summary: Run systemctl enable --now firewalld.
command_evidence: systemctl is-active firewalld; systemctl is-enabled firewalld

title: RHEL 9 audit service must be enabled.
check_summary: auditd.service must be enabled and running. Otherwise it is a finding.
fix_summary: Run systemctl enable --now auditd.
command_evidence: systemctl is-active auditd; systemctl is-enabled auditd

title: The systemd Ctrl-Alt-Delete burst key sequence in RHEL 9 must be disabled.
check_summary: CtrlAltDelBurstAction must be none in systemd config under /etc/systemd/system*. Other value, commented out, or missing is a finding.
fix_summary: Set CtrlAltDelBurstAction=none in a system.conf.d drop-in, then daemon-reload.

title: RHEL 9 must use a Linux Security Module configured to enforce limits on system services.
check_summary: getenforce must report Enforcing and /etc/selinux/config must set SELINUX=enforcing. Otherwise it is a finding.
fix_summary: Set SELINUX=enforcing in /etc/selinux/config and reboot.

title: RHEL 9 must enable the SELinux targeted policy.
check_summary: sestatus must show the loaded policy name as targeted. Any other policy is a finding.
fix_summary: Set SELINUXTYPE=targeted in /etc/selinux/config and reboot.

title: RHEL 9 must not have the telnet-server package installed.
check_summary: The telnet-server package must not appear in the installed package list. If installed, it is a finding.
fix_summary: Remove the package with dnf remove telnet-server.

title: RHEL 9 duplicate User IDs (UIDs) must not exist for interactive users.
check_summary: Scan /etc/passwd for UIDs shared by more than one account; a duplicate on an interactive account is a finding.
fix_summary: Edit /etc/passwd so each interactive account has a unique UID.

title: RHEL 9 must set the umask value to 077 for all local interactive user accounts.
check_summary: Search interactive users' init files for umask settings; any value less restrictive than 077 is a finding.
fix_summary: Remove umask statements from interactive users' init files so the system default applies.
command_evidence: grep -i umask in home-directory init files (.bashrc, .profile, etc.)

title: RHEL 9 user account passwords for new users or password changes must have a 60-day maximum password lifetime restriction in /etc/login.defs.
check_summary: PASS_MAX_DAYS in /etc/login.defs must be 60 or less. Higher or commented out is a finding.
fix_summary: Set PASS_MAX_DAYS 60 in /etc/login.defs.

title: RHEL 9 must implement address space layout randomization (ASLR) to protect its memory from unauthorized code execution.
check_summary: kernel.randomize_va_space must be 2 at runtime and in sysctl config files. Other value, missing, or conflicting is a finding.
fix_summary: Create a sysctl drop-in setting it to 2, remove conflicting entries, run sysctl --system.

title: RHEL 9 must have GPG signature verification enabled for all software repositories.
check_summary: Every repo file in /etc/yum.repos.d must set gpgcheck=1. Disabled, missing, or commented out is a finding unless an approved alternative verifies signatures.
fix_summary: Set gpgcheck=1 in all repo files under /etc/yum.repos.d, for example via sed.

title: RHEL 9 must disable storing core dumps.
check_summary: /etc/systemd/coredump.conf must set Storage=none. Missing, commented out, or another value is a finding unless documented as needed.
fix_summary: Add or modify Storage=none in /etc/systemd/coredump.conf.

title: RHEL 9 must display the Standard Mandatory DOD Notice and Consent Banner before granting local or remote access to the system via a command line user logon.
check_summary: /etc/issue must contain the required DoD notice text exactly. Missing, altered, or commented out is a finding.
fix_summary: Replace /etc/issue contents with the required DoD banner text.
